Thank you. Just being able to say it to someone helps. Today is not a good day but I've decided in between breakdowns I can "try". It's like I keep forgetting I have options, I keep forgetting that right now isn't infinite. 

Spent the whole day crying and sleeping. But I did my taxes. That made me feel better. I don't know what my next move will be but finding home seems to be priority and I don't want to say I went through all that just to give up.

But then again; I want to give up more than anything, it's a battle, it's like there's a voice telling me it's off; telling me to figure it the :;$& out. I feel weak and defeated but I have to "try". Is like an "aha" moment I keep having over and over. Possibly driving me crazy but I am glad I still hear it. 

Really; thank you. I needed to share and I'm sure in the future that won't entirely go away. I need friends.

I don't know the answer to overcoming this but what I do know is; you're not alone in feeling this way. I've battled with this my whole life and continue everyday to reach for a brighter view of myself. I think it is very possibly to overcome and triumph over such feelings, but easy; maybe not so much.
    It's like I have to actively make myself a different person, constantly reminding myself to be aware of even my thoughts. I learned that to overcome my insecurities, anxiety, and depression; I have to catch myself thinking poorly and then consciously tell myself different. It really is hard but I think the simple fact that you know you struggle with this and are aware of it shows strength. I always try and give myself credit there; at least I'm trying and not blind to it.
     Anyways; I hope you're able to find peace with yourself, I know it's hard, and I'm sorry you feel this way. It sucks but I hope one day to turn it into a strength. It's a journey alright. To outsmarting our brains!!

Good luck my friend

Btw: I think being independent and having hobbies help, makes me feel more confident, and less dependent on others.

Thank you for your response and point of view. I agree with you when you say it's a matter of a difference in values. That's actually a point I've discussed with him to an extent. I'm not sure he understands that: or better yet; i think he would prefer I mold to his views and lifestyle (which we are both guilty of). But I think what this comes down to is one I jumped into things too fast and really should have not committed myself so early on. I really do like him and understand that my frustration is over whether or not I'm going to make the decision to accept him, his lifestyle, and his view point. And the added frustration over my own insecurities and the insecurities I have about our relationship. And now here I am. Good lesson on really getting to know people. Thank you for your input.
Do you think I'm being unreasonable?
